page_title: NIC 2-0 MNT | Nice v Montpellier 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Willy Delajod is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Nice enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+3' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) commits a foul and Willy Delajod immediately signals a free kick. Montpellier have a free kick.
90+2' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Montpellier seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
88' Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!
87' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hicham Boudaoui.
87' A rebound falls kindly for Jordan Ferri (Montpellier), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
86' A dangerous looking corner kick from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cleared to safety by the defence.

86' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' Substitution. Tanguy Coulibaly leaves the pitch and is replaced by Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier).
83' The resulting corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) comes to nothing.
82' The linesman makes the right call and Nice will have a corner. A cross into the box from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is cleared.
81' The resulting corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

81' A sweet pass finds Gaetan Laborde (Nice) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Benjamin Lecomte is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Good work from Nice as they win a corner.
79' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
78' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mohamed-Ali Cho walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
76' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sofiane Diop (Nice) replacing Evann Guessand.
75' The resulting corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cleared by the defence.
74' Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Montpellier get a corner.
73' Looks like Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
72' The substitution has been made. Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) has replaced Theo Sainte-Luce.
72' The game is interrupted now, Teji Savanier (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) sees a yellow card from Willy Delajod after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
71' Flag up against Gaetan Laborde (Nice). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

70' Ooh that was close! Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
69' We are about to witness a substitution. Nicolas Pays (Montpellier) is replacing Andy Delort.
69' It's time for a substitution. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) comes on in place of Khalil Fayad.
69' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to make a change. Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) replaces Abdoul Bamo Meite.
65' 2 - 0 Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
64' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Baptiste Santamaria will be replaced by Pablo Rosario (Nice).
63' Substitution. Tom Louchet (Nice) replaces Ali Abdi.
63' Evann Guessand (Nice) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Willy Delajod who sees an offensive foul. Montpellier are awarded a free kick.
62' Evann Guessand (Nice) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
60' A pass by Andy Delort (Montpellier) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
57' The ratio of the ball possession is 61:39.
52' Nice are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
50' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Willy Delajod ignores the protests.
49' The corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cleared away by the defence.

48' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Now Montpellier have a corner.

48' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
47' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
47' Nice take a short corner kick.
46' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Nice win a corner.
46' Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Willy Delajod blows for a foul. A free kick to Nice.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+3' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
44' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Baptiste Santamaria (Nice). There is a free kick near the sideline to Montpellier.
42' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes.

40' Evann Guessand (Nice) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
39' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
39' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

39' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Baptiste Santamaria (Nice). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Nice will take a corner kick.
37' Nice have a free kick. Poor challenge! Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) is penalised for tripping and Willy Delajod blows his whistle.
36' The Montpellier players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

34' Excellent touch by Gaetan Laborde (Nice)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
33' Andy Delort (Montpellier) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.

30' 1 - 0 Jonathan Clauss (Nice) finds himself in a great position after receiving a precise pass inside the box and sends the ball beyond the goalkeeper! His effort went into the bottom left corner, off the post.
30' Flag goes up against Andy Delort (Montpellier) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
29' Nice take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' Evann Guessand (Nice) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice.
26' Andy Delort (Montpellier) tackles a bit over-zealously and Willy Delajod blows for a foul. Nice win a free kick.
23' Great teamplay by Nice as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
19' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
18' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Teji Savanier (Montpellier), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
17' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Montpellier.
16' Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
14' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Willy Delajod no option but to blow his whistle.
11' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
10' A pass into the box finds Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Benjamin Lecomte denies him.

9' The ball rebounds out to Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
6' The foul by Teji Savanier (Montpellier) was seen by Willy Delajod who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Nice are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
3' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Montpellier will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod is the one to supervise the game today.
